facts.notes: The retained STEP was authored on 2024-03-20 and remains linked by the current official resource page. That CAD date is not a product release date. Native millimetres, source topology and assembly positions are preserved; no source geometry is scaled to fit a photograph. USB orientation versus a particular factory firmware text direction has not been physically calibrated; the geometric view keeps native USB at negative Y. No enclosure, battery or external cable is supplied by this model. RESET is visible geometry only; reset remains a platform action. The live circular display is a 32.4 mm optical projection at the front cover plane, slightly offset to avoid coplanar rendering; it is not a manufactured laminate thickness. Photographic registration is approximate and does not certify hidden dimensions or physical fit. The LCD solid includes its folded flex tail; its total native depth is 1.7000001 mm while the mechanical drawing labels the LCD body as 1.55±0.1 mm. These different extents are retained, not forced into agreement. All 207 native components are retained, including two 1.27 mm receptacle assemblies visible in the exact product photographs.
